title: Chicken Adobo
content: A classic Filipino dish made with chicken marinated in soy sauce and vinegar.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and pepper in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Sinigang na Baboy
content: A Filipino pork soup with a tamarind broth.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: In a pot, combine pork, water, tomatoes, onion, and bring to a boil.
Add tamarind mix and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add green beans and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Pancit Bihon
content: Filipino rice noodle stir-fry with vegetables.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Heat oil in a pan and sauté garlic and onion.
Add carrots and cook for 3 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, soy sauce, and bring to a simmer.
Add bihon noodles and cook until soft and liquid is absorbed.
Serve hot.

title: Lumpiang Shanghai
content: Filipino spring rolls with ground pork filling.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: In a bowl, combine ground pork, carrots, onion, egg, and soy sauce.
Place a spoonful of the mixture in each spring roll wrapper and roll tightly.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the spring rolls until golden brown.
Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Kare-Kare
content: Filipino oxtail stew with peanut sauce.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Boil oxtail until tender, then set aside.
In a pot, sauté annatto powder in oil.
Add peanut butter and water, bring to a simmer.
Add oxtail and cook for 15 minutes.
Add eggplant and bok choy, cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve with rice and shrimp paste.

title: Lechon Kawali
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Season pork belly with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a deep pot.
Carefully add pork belly and deep fry until crispy and golden brown.
Drain on paper towels, then chop into pieces.
Serve with dipping sauce.

title: Tinola
content: A Filipino chicken soup with green papaya and ginger.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: In a pot, sauté onion and ginger in oil.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add chicken broth, bring to a boil.
Add green papaya and cook until tender.
Stir in fish sauce and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Tocino
content: Sweet cured pork typically served for breakfast.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Combine sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and pepper in a bowl.
Add pork and marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the pork until caramelized and cooked through.
Serve with rice and fried egg.

title: Bicol Express
content: Spicy pork stew in coconut milk and shrimp paste.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: In a pot, sauté garlic and onion in oil.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add shrimp paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add green chili peppers and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Halo-Halo
content: A popular Filipino cold dessert made with mixed fruits, beans, and shaved ice.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: In a tall glass, layer sweetened banana, sweet beans, jello, and ube halaya.
Add shaved ice to fill the glass.
Drizzle with evaporated milk.
Top with a slice of leche flan and a scoop of ice cream.
Mix together before eating.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
content: Classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and pepper.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Cook the spaghetti according to the packet instructions.
Meanwhile, cut the pancetta into lardons.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, and beat with the cheese and pepper.
Peel and slice the garlic.
Fry the pancetta and garlic.
Add the pasta to the pancetta pan.
Toss everything together and remove from the heat.
Mix in the egg mixture.
Serve with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Stir Fry
content: A quick and delicious chicken stir fry with mixed vegetables and a savory sauce.
author: 6476111ed0a0e0057360eeb6
preparation: Slice chicken into thin strips.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar for sauce.
Chop garlic and ginger.
Heat oil in pan, and cook chicken until browned.
Add garlic, ginger, and vegetables to the pan.
Cook for a few more minutes.
Add the sauce and cook until heated through.
